input.summary: Cut the § 3.2 non-renewal notice window from ninety (90) days to sixty (60) days.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have cut the non-renewal notice window from ninety (90) days to sixty (60) days so an early deadline cannot lock us into a further automatic renewal term; sixty (60) days is our fallback position (our preferred is a 30-day opt-out with a 60-day renewal reminder).

ops.oldText: unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least ninety (90) days prior to the end of the then-current term
ops.newText: unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least sixty (60) days (i.e., no more than 60 days) prior to the end of the then-current term
